findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l is not normalized to the manuscript reference build.
findings.recommendation: Normalize every variant to the manuscript reference build and report any liftover or remapping evidence.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l uses a transcript not declared in the methods.
findings.recommendation: State the canonical transcript and ensure HGVS claims use a transcript named in the methods.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l has incomplete HGVS nomenclature.
findings.recommendation: Provide complete HGVS cDNA and protein nomenclature before the claim is reviewer-ready.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l exceeds the rare-disease allele frequency threshold used by the manuscript.
findings.recommendation: Downgrade pathogenicity language or explain why population frequency is compatible with disease prevalence and penetrance.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l has unresolved ClinVar evidence that conflicts with strong pathogenicity language.
findings.recommendation: Add an adjudication note for ClinVar benign/conflicting evidence or revise the variant classification.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l is described with family segregation support, but the pedigree evidence is underpowered.
findings.recommendation: Treat segregation as supportive only after reporting informative meioses, LOD support, and unaffected-carrier checks.

findings.message: Claim claim-syn1-functional relies on functional evidence that is not reviewer-ready.
findings.recommendation: Require replicated functional assays with positive and negative controls before using functional rescue language.

findings.message: Comparison burden-syn1-cohort uses frequency enrichment without ancestry-matched support.
findings.recommendation: Match ancestry or stratify frequency comparisons before presenting case-control enrichment as variant evidence.

findings.message: Claim claim-syn1-computational-only uses strong pathogenicity language without orthogonal variant evidence.

evidence.text: Computational prediction alone confirms this SYN1 change is a disease-causing variant.

findings.recommendation: Replace pathogenic or causal language with candidate-variant language until orthogonal evidence is supplied.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l is claimed as disease-relevant with weak phenotype overlap.
findings.recommendation: Add HPO-level phenotype support or soften the asserted genotype-phenotype match.

findings.message: Variant var-syn1-p841l is missing callset reproducibility evidence.
findings.recommendation: Provide callset availability, validation method, pipeline version, and parameter digests for reviewer reproduction.
